note: Jasper County Conservation park of 113 acres of upland oak-hickory woods north of Mingo, entered beside the Ashton Chapel off W. 122nd St. N. Twelve primitive sites with a fire ring and table each, a shelter, a softball field, interpreted trails and an astronomical observatory. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $12 primitive sites (12, +$4 processing fee), online booking with a 2-night weekend minimum, 14-day limit, closed November 1 to April. County pages list drinking water, restrooms and showers, against the old note's 'no plumbing/water'. Fit unconfirmed; caveat proposed.
flags: FACILITIES conflict with the old note: Jasper County's park page lists 'Drinking Water' and 'Restrooms', and every campsite page's amenities list 'Restroom' and 'Shower facilities'. The old note said 'dry camping (no plumbing/water, vault toilet)', which matches camper reviews in search snippets (The Dyrt, Campendium). Those reviews say the campground has only a pit toilet, and that the flush toilets, hot shower and water spigot are at a bathroom up the road by the observatory. I wrote potable_water and showers true from the operator's pages, left the stored vault_toilets alone, and took the 'no plumbing/water' claim out of the note. If AWH reads 'at the campground' strictly, the water and showers are a short drive or walk away, at the observatory.

FIT / CAVEAT (lead): no pad lengths are posted. The county calls it 'Campground (Tent, Trailer, and Group)', and nothing singles it out as small-RV only. On NAIP the sites are in a small clearing under heavy oak canopy off a narrow gravel lane, so I can't see the pads. There's no clear limit, so it stays. Proposed caveat for the note: 'Pad sizes not posted: primitive wooded sites on a narrow gravel lane.' I didn't look for a dated review of a 23-ft+ rig fitting.
SEASON: 'Closed seasonally from November 1st till April' gives the closing date (10-31) and no opening day. opens is left unset.
PIN OK: 41.81139,-93.29419 is on the park road about 110 m east of the camp clearing (about 41.8113,-93.2955). Under the 250 m line.

PHONE (missing): the entry has none. The campsite pages give 'Ph: 641-792-9780' with the park address (8755 W 122nd St. N, Mingo). Website: mycountyparks is the operator's page; Jasper County's own page (https://jasperia.org/conservation/parks/ashton_wildwood_park/) could be added.
NOTE: the old note's 'dark-sky park' claim isn't on either county page, so it was dropped. Only the observatory is named.
